patch_description: Add a cheap short/long causal endpoint-slope consensus calculation inside the Kalman tracker and use it exclusively to modulate the process-noise adaptation. When 6-sample, 12-sample, and current state velocity agree, modestly increase maneuver responsiveness so coherent trends are tracked with less lag. When the short slope disagrees with the established velocity, reduce acceleration adaptation, preventing local endpoint jitter from rotating the tracker state and generating false reversals. The reported-output reversal controller remains unchanged, preserving its existing direction protection.
